rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the condition of being safe or secure.

example.english: I feel pretty good about the security here.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 ni1 dou6 gei2 on1 cyun4

rows.note: Use this for security staff, a security department, or security arrangements at a place.

example.english: The mall has stepped up security at the entrance.
example.traditional: 商場門口啲保安而家加強巡邏。
example.jyutping: soeng1 coeng4 mun4 hau2 di1 bou2 on1 ji4 gaa1 gaa1 koeng4 ceon4 lo4

rows.note: Use this when security means a guarantee securing an obligation, rather than physical collateral.

example.english: This receipt gives you security that you will get your money back.
example.traditional: 呢張收據係你攞得返錢嘅保證。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 sau1 geoi3 hai6 nei5 lo2 dak1 faan1 cin2 ge3 bou2 zing3

rows.note: Use this for protection or a protective measure that secures someone or something.

example.english: Having protection is what gives us security.
example.jyutping: jau5 bou2 wu6 sin1 zi3 on1 sam1
